summary: Iter10 BLOCKED at Phase 1 — cannot test the free-typing/blur-reset fix because /app/frontend/src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx FAILS TO COMPILE. Two critical implementation defects introduced in this iteration: (1) SYNTAX ERROR at line 771 — orphaned/duplicated code fragment from a stale PostSaveDialog copy (lines 771-815) sits AFTER the properly-closed PostSaveDialog at lines 703-770; webpack reports 'Missing semicolon. (771:16)' and app does not build. (2) MISSING COMPONENT — `MonthAmountInput` is referenced at line 677 as <MonthAmountInput month=... floor=... value=... onCommit=... /> but is NEVER defined nor imported anywhere in the repo (grep -rn 'MonthAmountInput' /app/frontend/src returns only the two lines inside FeesStructure.jsx: the comment at :449 and the JSX usage at :677). Even if the syntax error is fixed, React will crash at runtime with 'MonthAmountInput is not defined'. No frontend testing was possible; no backend regression was needed since the failure blocks the entire feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Orphaned duplicated code block at lines 771-815 (leftover copyAsDraft/return/JSX from a stale PostSaveDialog) after the properly-closed function at line 770. Babel: 'Missing semicolon. (771:16)'. Webpack build fails — the entire app does not load in the browser.

Referenced in JSX at line 677 but the component itself is never defined nor imported. This is THE new component the fix hinged on. Without it, even after the syntax error is fixed, the Fee Plan dialog will throw ReferenceError.

action_items: DELETE lines 771-815 of /app/frontend/src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx (orphaned duplicate leftover after PostSaveDialog closes at 770). The file should end at line 770 with the closing brace of PostSaveDialog, followed by a trailing newline.

IMPLEMENT the MonthAmountInput component in /app/frontend/src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx. Per the review-request spec: local text state, `press_sequentially`-friendly free typing (no clamping on keystroke), live-commit on valid values >= floor so preview updates, on blur: '' → onCommit(null) to reset to auto; below-floor → toast.warning('This month includes ₹X of one-time fees — the amount can't go below that.') + onCommit(floor); otherwise onCommit(Number(value)). Must render an <Input type='number' inputMode='decimal' data-testid={`month-amount-${month}`} /> so existing testids and Playwright scripts continue to work. min attribute should be `floor` (not enforced by browser during typing due to local state, but useful for step controls).

After both fixes, restart is unnecessary (hot reload). Verify webpack compiles cleanly and re-run the Playwright reproduction: type 4 → 40 → 400 → 4000 via press_sequentially in April (floor=5000), assert each intermediate value renders in the field, then blur and assert toast + reset-to-5000.

Main agent should re-open the file, verify the AST is valid, and consider running `yarn eslint src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx` before declaring completion.

setMonthAmount(:450) contract now depends on MonthAmountInput enforcing the floor on blur — semantically correct (recurring-only storage), but with MonthAmountInput missing, ANY previous test that typed a value into an existing month field can no longer be reproduced. Regression coverage was silently zeroed.

Recommend adding a Cypress/Playwright smoke test that just OPENS the Fee Plan dialog and asserts at least one month-amount-{n} input is visible — this would have caught the missing-component regression immediately.

rca of the issue: Root cause: the file save that added MonthAmountInput to /app/frontend/src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx was botched — the new component definition was never actually written to disk, AND an old copy of the PostSaveDialog body (from before it was extracted / edited) was left dangling as orphaned code at lines 771-815. Result: (1) Babel parser encounters a bare template literal `"${data?.name}" created — edit it without affecting students`);` at module scope on line 771 and errors with 'Missing semicolon. (771:16)'; (2) even after that block is removed, the JSX at line 677 references an undefined identifier `MonthAmountInput`, so React would throw at render time. Neither the syntax error nor the missing-component regression was caught before handoff because no build/lint check ran. Reproduction: `tail -n 30 /var/log/supervisor/frontend.out.log` immediately shows the compile error; `grep -rn MonthAmountInput /app/frontend/src` shows the component is not defined.
